notes.title: Day 6 of CBT2 - We Hear You!
notes.content:
What's up, ballers!
CBT2 has been dropping dimes for six days straight. These past six days, we've seen countless clutch moments and felt pure fire from every single one of you. Every bucket, every matchup, every piece of feedback – we've got it locked down.
This isn't just a test; it's a team-up, a journey we're on together.


[h1]We're rolling out a hotfix, tomorrow without downtime to square away some issues:[/h1]

We're planning a hotfix on [b]June 24th[/b] to tackle the following:
- Adding multilingual display for "Private" info on personal profiles.
- Tweaking the volume and rhythm of the lobby's background music.
- Optimizing multi-language localization, fixing some UI text layout issues and inconsistent translations.
- Patching up the frequent "Reconnecting to server failed multiple times" prompts in-game.
- Correcting language display errors for the "accept" and "reject" buttons in invite prompts.
- Resolving issues where some parameters weren't called successfully.
- To resolve error code 10011 caused by network issues in the launcher, please log out of your account, clear the cache, completely close the launcher (including background processes), then restart and log in again.
For detailed steps on how to clear the cache, please visit:
 https://www.free-dunk.com/news/RMXab190739458
All these updates are based on player feedback, and we appreciate your patience and assists. Plus, we're still working on other bugs you've reported and will hit you up with updates ASAP once they're fixed.

[h1]Player Feedback Central & Priority Fix List (TODO LIST)[/h1]
We've racked up some valuable feedback and suggestions these past few days. We've got them on the board as high-priority items:
[h2]1. Rebounding, Stealing, & Blocking Mechanics[/h2]
Many of you felt the "rebounding, stealing, and blocking felt weird." We get it. We've broken down the current in-game logic and mechanics to help you understand the hustle behind every loose ball

[h3]1. Rebounding Mechanics[/h3]
- Timing the board: When the ball starts to descend and flashes, hitting the D button will give you a better shot at securing the rebound.
- Rebound success rate is affected by multiple factors like positioning, height, wingspan, jump, Rebound attribute, and the strength of the rebound-specific skills used.
- Lower network latency (ping) in-game gives you an edge in grabbing boards under the same conditions.
- Pro Tip: Box-out is key to the rebound game. After using a box-out skill, opponents within a 120-degree fan-shaped area behind your player won't be able to snag the board, even if they jump.
[h3]2. Stealing Mechanics[/h3]
- When swiping, the closer you are to the ball-handler's dribbling hand, the higher your success rate. Trying from the opposite side will significantly drop your chances.
- The closer you are to the ball, the higher your steal success rate.
- Higher Steal attribute and skill strength (e.g., Quick Steal is better than Normal Steal, advanced skills trump basic ones) boost your success rate. Success rate has an inverse relationship with the opponent's Dribble attribute.
- Pro Tip: Your steal success rate will jump significantly if you swipe after stopping a dribbler.
[h3]3. Blocking Mechanics[/h3]
- Timing: Different layup and shot animations (including trick moves) have unique block spots (optimal block timing). You'll need practice to master these; hitting the block spot makes it easier to swat the shot.
- Angle: When blocking, you need to be in a direct line between the offensive player and the hoop, as blocks require a specific angle.
- Distance: Some block moves have distance requirements. For example, to block a long-distance dunk, you need to be positioned closer.
- Assuming the above conditions are met, the defender's height, wingspan, Block attribute, block skill strength, and the offensive player's Offensive attribute all impact block success rate.
Based on your current feedback, [b]we're prioritizing optimizing rebound performance to make the feedback[/b] clearer and the feel more solid when triggered. If you've ever felt like you "touched it but it didn't count" in-game, please tell us: which player you were using, what move, and the in-game situation. This is huge for our optimization work.


[h2]2. Player Progression & Balance Adjustments[/h2]
This is a hot topic for many players, especially those who've played other versions. Rest assured, FREE DUNK is built on a fresh concept. Big shout out to players and partners from other versions who gave us the opportunity to bring this title to you – seriously, thank you. But FREE DUNK's design logic is different from past products. Even though we consider them "our own kids."
[b]For future versions, we're making these adjustments to progression and balance:[/b]
- Redesigning the account and player growth rhythm, adding clear guidance.
- Designing more progressive missions and rewards based on player development paths.
- Pack and training resource allocation will be more aligned with actual player needs and pace.
- For balance, we'll keep fine-tuning skills and stats by referencing character usage rates, win rates, and community feedback.


[h2]3. Future of Squad & Badge Systems[/h2]
We've recently received a lot of feedback and questions about the Squad and Badge systems. Here's some extra info and our game plan:
[h3]1. Badge System Expansion & Clarification[/h3]
It might be that our in-game explanations weren't clear enough, leading to some misunderstandings. To clarify: Badge buffs currently apply at the entire account level. Whether you're in Quick Match or Arcade Mode, as long as you've got badges equipped, their effects are active.
We'll keep expanding badge types, sources, and strategic pairings to add more depth and strategy to this system.
[h3]2. Squad System Optimization[/h3]
The Squad system is still in its early stages. We'll keep optimizing the experience, including linups management, player configuration, and squad progression, so this system can carry more advanced gameplay in the future.
[h3]3. Integrating Squad Play with Arcade Mode[/h3]
We're also cooking up plans to bring squad mechanics into Arcade Mode, letting you roll with your custom-built team in more games, breaking free from single-mode limits. Plus, we've started internal talks about community ideas like "team-up Arcade" and "squad leagues," and we're hyped to make them happen with you down the road.

[h1]Report Tech Issues & Bugs[/h1]

We're super sorry about any bumps in the road right now. We know FREE DUNK isn't perfect out of the gate, but we're committed to fixing it with max effort and action.
If you're down to help us out, please hook us up with the following info whenever you hit a snag:
- Player ID
- Operating System (Win10 or Win11, 32 or 64-bit)
- Network Connection (Wi-Fi, wired, VPN, etc.)
- Screenshot or video of the issue happening
- Game log files (In the launcher, click {Open Directory} → find the {LocalLog} folder → send us the files from that time period)
Your assists will seriously speed up our fixes. Thank you!

[h1]About Live Streams – You Dig This Vibe?[/h1]
We also ran some live stream events during this CBT2 run:
- From the creator showdown of "台灣噁男 vs. 偉民與宇軒"
- To the epic best-of-seven clash "波謙 vs. TheAnswer"
We saw players with different styles, strategies, and in-game moves, and felt the community's passion.
So, do you like these kinds of live streams and events?
What kind of creator collabs or match formats do you want to see in the future?
Hit us up in the comments, or drop your suggestions on Discord / via customer service email.
And if you're looking to join the creator crew, feel free to sign up for our creator event: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeQZmgElUjgv99GfgubmRZa8bJ7Sy-ohj2jdS4Qtvr6nJb1RA/viewform

[h1]Finally, Thanks for Hooping With Us[/h1]
FREE DUNK isn't a perfect game from day one. But we're striving to make it better, little by little, with every chat with players, every update, and every tweak.
What you're giving us isn't just test data; it's the fuel for growth and the direction we're headed. We've got more updates, events, and content cooking up, and we're hyped to bring you a more complete game on launch day.
Big thanks again to everyone who jumped into CBT2. We'll keep grinding, and we're looking forward to walking this path with you all.

—— ALLEYSFIELD

notes.title: FREE DUNK CBT2 FAQ
notes.content:
Hey Ballers!
Welcome to the second Closed Beta Test (CBT2) for FREE DUNK! 
We've put together this FAQ to help you jump into the game smoothly. It covers everything from registration and downloads to gameplay, device support, player progression, talent mechanics, and the new Squad system. If you're new here, no worries—we'll help you get up to speed fast!

[h1]1. Basic Test Info[/h1]
[h2]1.1 Test Duration & Type[/h2]
- Test Duration: June 18, 2025, 07:00 PM – June 30, 2025, 03:00 AM (PDT, UTC-7)
- Test Type: Closed Beta, data will be wiped after the test
- Supported Languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Korean
- Test Access: Official players can get access by pre-registering, Steam players can apply for access.

[h2]1.2 How to Participate[/h2]
No activation code is needed; simply register an account to participate.
- Supported Platform: PC
  - Official Client Download (Recommended for Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia): https://www.free-dunk.com/download
  - Steam Playtest (Recommended for North American users): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562050

[h2]1.3 Client Installation Instructions[/h2]
- Please only download and install the client from the official website or Steam page.
- If you encounter installation issues, please disable your antivirus software or run as administrator.


[h1]2. Account Registration & Login[/h1]
[h2]2.1 How to Create an Account?[/h2]
- Supports registration using major email services.
- We recommend using Gmail for better stability and reliability.

[h2]2.2 Common Issues[/h2]
- "Username already exists": Please check if you've already registered successfully; you can retrieve your account using "Forgot Password."
- Didn't receive verification code: Please confirm your email address is correct and check your spam folder.

[h2]2.3 Password & Account Security Tips[/h2]
- You can reset your password by clicking "Forgot Password" on the login page.
- Do not enter your account information on unofficial pages.
- We recommend setting a strong password and changing it regularly to prevent account theft.

[h1]3. Device Configuration & Operation Support[/h1]
[h2]3.1 Recommended Specs[/h2]
- Operating System: 64-bit Windows 10
- Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or equivalent
- RAM: 16 GB RAM
- Graphics Card: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or equivalent
- DirectX Version: 6.0
- Storage: At least 15 GB available space
- Network: Broadband internet connection

[h2]3.2 Minimum Specs[/h2]
- Operating System: 64-bit Windows 10
- Processor: Intel Core i5-4460
- RAM: 8 GB RAM
- Graphics Card: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950Ti (2GB) or equivalent
- DirectX Version: 6.0
- Storage: At least 15 GB available space
- Network: Broadband internet connection

[h2]3.3 Controller Support[/h2]
- Supports keyboard + mouse operation.
- Supports Xbox / PlayStation series and standard USB gamepads.

[h1]4. Gameplay & Operation Guide[/h1]
[h2]4.1 What game modes and features are available in this test?[/h2]
This test features Arcade Mode, Custom Match, Quick Match, Practice Mode, Squad Mode, Training Center, Free Training and more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/176336d6a530eb9e8bc5034ab8a781c5f9d452b7.png[/img]

[b]Arcade Mode:[/b]
Players kick off their career from Prodigy Journey, progressing to a superstar by playing matches, completing quests, boosting player stats, and leveling up to unlock new skills—it's the full basketball journey. This Arcade Mode now includes Leaderboards and an Honor system, with leaderboards updating every hour to make sure every bit of your grind is recognized. You'll get 5 streetball coins daily, and each successful run costs 1 coin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/930824cf935d60c6b7ea82f7bd593d11ec094e44.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/4cae3ff80b1f03d15f8b4c6f19189c53043c5d35.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/89166c0b94f9c882b8aaa59df42c43aeb5916110.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/2bed3af3c49040b3c74fee80afd9706ea4a05ba4.png[/img]

[b]Custom Match:[/b]
You call the shots here! Customize the court, time, and match rules for a truly personalized game experience. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/8595b9680b53dd7910dac8096f463b09dc2a96e0.png[/img]

With this update, you can now create private password-protected rooms to invite specific friends for small tournaments or use Quick Recruit to instantly gather teammates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/a705ce8e933e3e84d8bad8d2273a3fb90ee51c66.png[/img]

[b]Squad Mode:[/b]
Squad Mode is where you build your own crew. You can unlock it once your account reaches Lv. 5 and you own three players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/16ebdb19aa0cb1175238c1de4b8f6e945661385f.png[/img]

[b]Quick Match:[/b]
Jump into Quick Match and choose between "Finding Match" or start Squad Mode 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/fbeb7da2a366f2a83855652b668249b7971dc646.png[/img]

[b]Practice Mode:[/b]
Use Practice Mode for specialized training, with pro AI helping you level up your game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/6e2411b95b101a94ac6ac8067dbd765aa2e7c4eb.png[/img]

[b]Training Center:[/b]
The Training Center currently offers two main sections: Basic Training and Advanced Training. Basic Training will help you understand the game's core controls and mechanics, while Advanced Training delves into specific player abilities, making it a prime platform for becoming a court veteran.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/d3b60fc241a40b4e213fcc3838fc0ac4cbb73d90.png[/img]

[h2]4.2 How to Build Your Own Superstar?[/h2]
You can boost your players' abilities through the "Training" and "Potential" systems found in the "Player" interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/1702c9fe56a776d3ee2eb7c93dabcb51e804fc2e.png[/img]

By spending Game Points, you can train a player's core stats like Dunk, Running, or 3point. Each stat has a growth cap, maxing out at +10 (player-dependent). Once a training level hits +7, you'll need special training items to keep pushing forward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/3c44c21505421aee7d324d0a575e2bf827f44e96.png[/img]

Trick Moves Activation Cards, earned from events and quests, let you unlock exclusive shooting and offensive moves in the "Trick Moves" system. Each Trick Move comes with visual effects and a 1-3% bonus effect chance (only active when the move triggers).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/d3b3764b755c50bbba04cde452dd686ff30b7a92.png[/img]

The "Talent System" lets you allocate Potential Points to specific positions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/0ed65b73fc03db5b5aebc914e8a68d516e119a5e.png[/img]

Using Potential Points improves a player's key trigger abilities or adaptability for breakthrough angles. Every point spent delivers noticeable in-game feedback. You'll earn core points at account Lv. 10, Lv. 15, and Lv. 20. These core points significantly boost specialized abilities, helping you deliver clutch plays when it matters most!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/d8c0056f31dc157b6fd18de6da6bfb02f6b4f38b.png[/img]

Earn Player XP Books by completing in-game quests and participating in events. These XP Books will help you quickly level up your players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/d524677055abb2b0b2551b90f4e787e98f45209b.png[/img]

[h2]4.3 How to Build Your Own Squad?[/h2]
You can establish your own Squad through the "Squad" system. The game currently offers three custom Lineup slots, which unlock as your Squad level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/2c08fda537f4856043d3371169b7189c638cd575.png[/img]

By participating in matches, you can earn loot and obtain "Badge" gift boxes from loot chests. Equipping Badges will boost your players' abilities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/d26b82df59ddfd0a1357f96bbc29bed0dacee06a.png[/img]

Squad Mode is accessed via Quick Match. To unlock Squad Mode, you need to own three players and have an account that is Lv. 5 or higher.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/d4320f85eced785cc81b5aa02fff38caa09ef595.png[/img]

In Squad Mode, you have the choice to let the system control your team, or you can take the reins and play with all three players yourself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/2d819748973181462d6d2cb73b9a8e950a0c5d62.png[/img]

[h2]4.4 Controls & Game Settings[/h2]
From the game's main page, press the ESC key to find the "Return to Login Screen" and "Settings" options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/70744934ab8ad64435f368c99dc9764133751cc3.png[/img]

The game offers multiple control schemes. Press ESC, navigate to "Settings," and click on "Controls" to adjust them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/cd38e076010b1d466f056fb80bb6e69bdbb4ff9a.png[/img]

You can also access the "Settings" menu by clicking the Gear icon at the bottom of the interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/f4a5d116d427b2b6995c05db6b377ac3579cdc45.png[/img]

Additionally, you can change the interface language and other game settings in the "Gameplay" section.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/28ab60e658010967a41ae9e645526bbaf723beec.png[/img]

[h2]4.5 How to Redeem Your Redemption Code[/h2]
You can open the redemption interface by clicking the "Redeem" icon at the bottom of the game screen to enter your redemption code.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/56b8b83b24f91d9c9b95a3b8653052a59be8ae63.png[/img]

After successful redemption, items will be sent to your in-game "Mailbox," so be sure to claim them promptly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/58359bd718d5b2e1df1fcadb48366363a5e704f3.png[/img]

[h2]4.6 Personal Profile, Career, Honor, Player Stats, and Match History[/h2]
You can access your Personal Profile by clicking on your avatar. Here, you can view your game career, player stats, match history, and achievements. You can also edit your personal information and check your Credit System status from this interface. If you need to find your ID, you can copy it from your Personal Profile.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/99aa3fbce9ac6674bcff4164bfd3ce3a02b7c876.png[/img]

[h1]5. Technical Issues & Feedback[/h1]
[h2]5.1 What if the game crashes, lags, or shows a black screen?[/h2]
If you run into these issues, try the following troubleshooting steps first:
- Lower your graphics settings, resolution, and effects level.
- Close background programs to free up memory.
- Reinstall the client, making sure you have the full installation package from the official website.
- Check your internet connection and speed to ensure they're normal.
Note: Services in mainland China are provided by other operators, so login is not currently available there.

[h2]5.2 What if the Steam interface is laggy?[/h2]
Some players might hit page stuttering or delayed loading when logging into the game a second time via Steam. This might mess with your Lobby flow or Match Mode experience.
If you're facing unresponsive clicks or lagging pages, try this quick fix:
Enter the game, then go to [Practice] → [Single Player] Once you're on the training court, hit [ESC] to return to the Lobby. This should significantly smooth things out.
We apologize for the trouble! Our tech squad has found the issue and is working fast to drop a fix.

[h2]5.3 How do I report bugs or suggest features?[/h2]
- Join the official Discord community: https://discord.gg/freedunk and submit your issues in the #bug-report or #suggestions channels.
- Contact official customer service via email: af_cs@free-dunk.com

[h1]6. Other Frequently Asked Questions[/h1]
[h2]6.1 How are AFK and negative behaviors handled?[/h2]
The game has a built-in AFK detection mechanism. If a player is reported multiple times or identified by the system, penalties such as point deductions and match bans will be enforced.

[h2]6.2 How long after the test will the official version launch?[/h2]
The official launch is estimated to require another 3-6 months of development and optimization. Please stay tuned to official announcements for the specific timing.
If you encounter any problems during the test, feel free to contact the development team. We are committed to listening to every player's feedback to ensure a smooth official launch!

notes.title: CBT2 Update Revealed: Build Your Exclusive Team
notes.content:
Greetings, Ballers!

Less than two months after the first test concluded, we're back on the court, fueled by your anticipation and feedback.
On June 18, 2025, at 7:00 PM PDT (UTC-7), FREE DUNK CBT2 is officially set to begin! This isn't just a technical test; it's the next stop in our collective journey to refine our dream.
We firmly believe: as long as you don't give up, the final whistle will never blow.
"Goal: Over the Top" — This isn't just FREE DUNK's slogan, but also our unwavering belief in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/78bcc1596b7c2a4c3994c740840a94e3f0617abe.png[/img]

FREE DUNK is more than just a basketball game; it's a way to express freedom, a tribute to the love of basketball, and a vision we've always strived to achieve — [b]allowing every basketball lover to own their own team, their own court, and a stage where they can continuously grow, challenge themselves, and surpass their limits. We hope this becomes a place that every basketball player can call "my court."[/b]
In this test, we're bringing five major core updates: a brand-new [b]Team Management system, arcade mode revolution, upgraded custom match, and optimized interactive experience.[/b] Every change is our response after carefully listening to your feedback.

[h1]Team System Alpha Version: The Era of Player "Team" Development Begins[/h1]

Basketball has never been a solo battle. A true "team" is more than just a collection of players; it's a vibrant, characterful, and stylistic fighting unit. With the [b]Team Management System (Alpha)[/b] introduced in this update, you will become the architect of your own squad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/3df88b9106505a64a073b83a5a765d50cf456ddc.png[/img]

[h2]Freely Assemble Team Lineups[/h2]
- You can freely assign your owned players into multiple team lineups.
- Initially, a maximum of three team lineups will be available, with more to be unlocked as your team's level increases in the future. 
[h2]Team Experience and Level[/h2]
- Every match played with a team lineup will accumulate experience for your team.
- Increasing your team's level will unlock more lineup slots and boost your overall team's combat power cap
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/ed0d0ca7022dcc7aa6cfde54c9410756335f0e9a.png[/img]

[h2]Tactical Personalization: Badge System[/h2]

- A new "Team Badge" system has been added. Badges are divided into three categories: Offense, Organization, and Defense, each representing a core dimension of team tactics.
- Each team lineup can have an[b] independent badge configuration[/b], allowing you to choose different badge combinations to create your unique playstyle.
- Badges come in different qualities and levels, and can be gradually upgraded by accumulating resources from team matches. 
This means you can have a powerful defensive team centered around "iron-blooded rebounding," or you can build a fast, small lineup focused on "fast break transitions and open three-pointers." You will embody the dual role of "Coach + Agent," defining the construction, coordination, and growth direction of your entire team.

[h1]Four Major Arcade Mode Updates: One Step at a Time, Forge Superstars[/h1]

[h2]The PVE[/h2] system has always been a crucial part of FREE DUNK that we highly value. In our hearts, every "superstar" should be forged through continuous, incremental effort and training.
FREE DUNK's Arcade Mode is your proving ground for honing these "superstars." This updated Arcade Mode will transform every ounce of your effort and every drop of sweat into clear records and achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/1f2b58aed03aca4c1910f737e2251d38235efebb.png[/img]

[h2]1、Leaderboard System Goes Live: Make Every Training Session Valuable[/h2]

- Introducing both a "All Player Leaderboard" and "Individual Player Leaderboards," recording players' clear scores, times, data, and more across various metrics.
- Whether you're an all-rounder or a specialist with a particular player, you can leave your mark on the rankings.
- Leaderboards will refresh hourly and settle quarterly, with TOP players receiving rewards like avatar frames, exclusive titles, and commemorative badges.
[h2]2、Honor System Expansion: Growth Trajectory at a Glance[/h2]
 
- Player-Exclusive Honors: Unlock "Proficiency" and "Signature Move" medals after reaching a certain usage frequency with a player.
- Seasonal Honor Titles: Titles such as "Block King," "Assist King," and "Rebound King" will gradually unlock as you accumulate stats.
- Extreme Challenge Achievements: Complete special objectives, like "Flawless Run," to earn exclusive titles that bear the player's name.
[h2]3、Real-Time Display Mechanism: Who is the King of the Streets, Instantly Clear[/h2]

- Each stage interface will display the current Top 3 clear records and data across the entire server.
- You're no longer just practicing alone; you're challenging the highest level on the entire server.
[h2]4、Optimized Challenge Pace: Play Long, Play Smart[/h2]
- Daily challenge limits and fixed-point refresh have been implemented to prevent repetitive grinding fatigue.
- A new limited-time mission reward system has been added to encourage you to use different players and try various playstyles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/5ce3bd81284a2a33b03a925927cfb2914e49cba8.png[/img]

[h1]Custom Match System Evolution: The First Step Towards Player Co-creation[/h1]

We've always hoped that you, wouldn't just "play matches" on the court, but also "host matches" yourselves. In this CBT2, the Custom Match system will also be updated, laying the groundwork for a future UGC (User-Generated Content) match ecosystem.
- [b]Password Room Settings[/b]: Freely adjust match time, rules, lineup restrictions, and more.
-  [b]Initiate Recruitment Function[/b]: A convenient team-up mechanism goes live, providing a foundation for match organization.
- [b]Spectate and Reward Mechanism (Planned)[/b]: In the next phase, we plan to support spectating and custom reward settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/bfe9009630a355c13c1fb4db288648930e591487.png[/img]

[h1]UI & Interaction Experience Optimization: Those Details You Complained About, We're on it[/h1]

We've received all the feedback you provided during the first test, and we are progressively implementing improvements:
- The Lobby now supports player skin and status display, fully showcasing the protagonist's charisma.
- Prodigy Journey, task Guidance, beginner guidance have been comprehensively optimized.
- Report and Redemption entry points have been moved for a cleaner, more streamlined experience.
- Multi-language adaptation and text overlap fixes are gradually progressing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/7fefb124200bc902b320a743a5155d38d4259944.png[/img]

[h1]We're Still on the Court, The Next Play is Yours![/h1]

We know that this CBT2 version isn't yet perfect, and there's still plenty of room for optimization.
But now, more than ever, we clearly understand that we are on this journey with you, and you've been with us every step of the way.
Team Management, players, matches, custom modes, leaderboards—this is just the beginning.
FREE DUNK is a court built together with you. Every brick and tile contains your suggestions and expectations.
Thank you for being willing to create this dream with us.
Our journey won't stop; step by step, we will make FREE DUNK the truly ideal basketball world in your mind.

See you on the court for CBT2 on June 18th!
FREE DUNK – Goal: Over the Top

The first beta test has been live for 24 hours! During this time, we’ve been filled with gratitude and excitement, and we sincerely appreciate your support and participation.

This test was not only a technical validation for us but also the starting point of building this game together with our players.
Your feedback has reinforced our belief that Free Dunk is more than just a game—it’s a world that belongs to every basketball lover.
Every suggestion has been carefully documented and compiled into a Todo List, which will guide our future updates.

[h1]Phase 1 Todo List[/h1]
Seeing your interactions in the Discord channel and in-game world chat has filled us with excitement and appreciation.
[b]Every piece of feedback, every issue reported, is invaluable to us. [/b]
Below is an update on the major issues we’ve identified and their current resolution status. We will continue to track, optimize, and implement fixes in upcoming versions：
[h2]Core Gameplay Issues[/h2]
 [h3]Arcade Mode Completion Failure[/h3]
Some players reported not receiving rewards after completing Arcade Mode matches. This issue has been identified, and we are working on a fix as quickly as possible.  Special thanks to "白靈子" for providing detailed clues.
[h3] Arcade Mode Reward Anomalies[/h3]
The issue with incorrect point rewards in Arcade Mode has been investigated and will be fixed soon.
 [h3]Settings Button Unresponsive / Resolution Blur or Adjustment Failure[/h3]
Some players encountered issues when clicking the settings button or adjusting resolution, leading to blurry visuals or display errors. This has been marked as high priority and will be addressed in a future update.
[h3] Skill Interface Crash[/h3]
The crash occurring when clicking "Confirm" in the skill description screen has been logged. After investigation, we found it was caused by unstable network connections. We are currently retesting server stability and optimizing performance.
[h3]Language Settings & Tutorial Issues[/h3]
Some players reported incorrect language detection and being unable to switch languages before completing certain tutorials. We are refining the detection logic and improving the language-switching process for future updates.
[h2]Display & Text Issues[/h2]
 [h3]UI Overlapping / Display Abnormalities[/h3]
 The following interface display issues are being addressed and will be optimized soon:
  - Overlapping icons and text in the skin interface
  - Multi-line text overlap in the Trick Moves interface during full-screen mode
  - Font stacking in the "F Key" prompt after scoring
  - Misaligned pop-ups after resolution changes
 [h3]Skill Description Errors[/h3]
Some skill descriptions were reported as incorrect (e.g., QiQi’s in-game block skill description). We are conducting a full review to ensure all skill descriptions match their actual effects.
 [h3]Offline Friend Status Display Error[/h3]
 Some players’ offline friends were incorrectly displayed. This has been confirmed as a refresh mechanism issue and will be fixed soon.
[h2]Network & Regional Connection Issues[/h2]
 [h3]North America[/h3]
We’ve received feedback from players in North America about latency issues. Since this is our first technical test, we initially set up servers in Asia, where we have more experience. However, we are now preparing North American servers and plan to provide a more stable experience for NA players in the next test. We look forward to meeting you again in better shape!

A heartfelt thank you to all the players who helped us identify these issues and provided valuable feedback. We bow in gratitude.

notes.title: Your Time to Shine! FREE DUNK First Playtest Launches April 18!
notes.content:
Hello, basketball lovers!

We're AlleysField, an independent development team that's been making basketball games for 20 years—and we're still as passionate as ever. Today, with both nervous excitement and high hopes, we're thrilled to announce: FREE DUNK's first playtest (Early Access) officially begins on April 18, 2025, 03:00 (PDT, UTC-7)!

Watch our vision video here>>https://youtu.be/UAjYa6o3f7M 

[h1]Our Vision for FREE DUNK[/h1]
We're not just game developers—we're basketball apprentices chasing a dream.
Over two decades, we've worked on many basketball games—some successful, some not. In success, we never stopped pushing forward. In failure, we never gave up.

Every day for 20 years, we've asked ourselves: What kind of basketball game truly captures the spirit of the sport?

Today, our answer is: A game that's passionate, progressive, free, and inclusive
Basketball isn't just competition—it's culture, adrenaline, even belief.
We want FREE DUNK to be more than a game. We want it to be an online home for every basketball fan.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/ef4a614e85f88f233634da2ca9a68b42a1d6946d.jpg[/img]
In our vision, FREE DUNK is a digital arena where every player belongs.
Whether you're a seasoned half-court veteran or a newcomer picking up a ball for the first time, we want you to find your place here. This game isn't just about competition—it's about memories, passion, and connections. You'll carve out your own rhythm on the court and, through relentless practice, watch yourself and your player grow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/288dad7c998cfeb0438b4d3a08990b7f6d0bb9ea.jpg[/img]
FREE DUNK is also a basketball platform without limits or labels.

We believe basketball's magic lies in its boundless possibilities. In FREE DUNK, you won't be confined by "definitions." Drain threes with a 7'1" giant or dominate the paint with a 5'3" guard. While the current version assigns basic roles, future updates will break all restrictions and templates. In FREE DUNK, only skill and creativity determine your place on the court. Play your way—free from traditional roles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/207ff04177e41a8a595a92546fae6b241fbe2e85.jpg[/img]
Ultimately, we want FREE DUNK to grow with players into a living, evolving basketball world.

In the near future, we will continue to improve the "Self-Organized Tournament System", allowing every player to freely set rules, invite friends to form teams, and create their own exclusive competitions. We also plan to launch various small-scale cooperative gameplay modes, enabling you and your teammates to cooperate seamlessly, fight side by side, and experience the unique charm of team basketball.

Of course, there's also the annual grand celebration - the Global Finals, the dream stage for all players. By accumulating points through regular competitions, as long as you're strong and consistent enough, you can advance to the global finals and compete against top players from around the world!

[h1]How to Get Playtest Access?[/h1]
Visit free-dunk.com, click "Pre-Register", and sign up!
Hit 1 million pre-registrations to unlock the exclusive open-beta player "Wukong" for all playtesters! Plus, get a chance to win PS5, Switch, and other epic rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574558/286cdcac03efd05965ac55e5813ea9adb1eaa1ad.jpg[/img]

Currently, FREE DUNK has officially launched accounts on the following platforms. Players worldwide can follow us to get the latest updates, exchange tactical insights, and participate in our game co-creation program:

We know FREE DUNK isn't perfect yet. But we believe every improvement comes from your feedback.
Your suggestions, your playtest experiences—we'll listen and improve.
We promise to polish every detail until FREE DUNK becomes the basketball game you've always wanted.
